parsed.reason: Description A says the handler fails to return after rejecting on ETA conversion error, so the task falls through and executes immediately ignoring its ETA; it also notes the failure isn't stored in the result backend. Description B says the removed mark_as_failure call was the only place storing the conversion error on the result backend, so clients never see FAILURE. They share the result-backend-not-recorded point, but A's primary defect is the missing return causing immediate execution, while B's is a regression from a removed call. Different root causes are described, so these are not the same defect.
